newsitem.title: GERMANY: Postbank in co-operation talks with DSL.
newsitem.headline: Postbank in co-operation talks with DSL.

text.p: Postbank AG, Germany's soon-to-be privatised postal bank, on Wednesday said it had been discussing a co-operation with the state-owned Deutsche Siedlungs und Landesrentenbank (DSL Bank) for some time.
A spokesman for the bank, however, declined to confirm or deny a report released in advance by the Wirtschaftswoche magazine that it planned to take over a majority stake in DSL.
However he said the two banks had been in talks on a possible co-operation for some time.
The Wirtschaftswoche said that Postbank planned to take over DSL in a transaction due to be completed by the start of 1998, ahead of Postbank's planned privatisation next summer.
Former DSL chief executive Dieter Boening took over as chief of Postbank on July 1.
